recap.text: Sierra, a Northropi Vampire and level sixty-five Neighborhood Boss, slams into Crawler Carl and pulls him down by his legs and chest. Crawler Donut uses Magic Missile and a light like a new sun to set Sierra's head on fire. Crawler Carl falls from the sky and tears through her chest, then stabs a jagged broken branch into her beating heart. Miriam Dom tells Crawler Carl that Sierra was Viscount Fog's flying mount.

beats.headline: Out of the storm
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Carl is levitating above the forest in a freezing downpour, and has just spotted Miriam Dom's sparks when something slams into him from the side. The spell snaps off and he falls, then freezes in midair as the boss music starts. Special Forest Encounter. Two talons hang fifteen feet away. The shape is the same kind of mob as Quetzalcoatlus from the last floor, but flesh and undead: a pelican crossed with a vulture, the size of a flying giraffe, a beak as long as Crawler Carl. Sierra. Northropi Vampire. Level sixty-five Neighborhood Boss.
beats.gist: Carl levitates in a freezing downpour and spots Miriam Dom's sparks before something slams into him.

beats.headline: A bereft minion
beats.text: Her description files her as a Bereft Minion of Viscount Fog, the now-deceased hunter of vampires, who trained his trusty mount never to leave his side. Together they hunted evil. When Fog set out to exterminate a newcomer, a vampire by the name of Miriam Dom, it went bad. Sierra swept down to save her master, was injured by Miriam, and stumbled away. In less than a day the bloodlust ravaged her. Now on the hunt for her first kill, she has become what she and her master hated most. Free her from her misery.
beats.gist: Sierra is a Bereft Minion of Viscount Fog who became a vampire after Miriam Dom injured her.

beats.headline: Holy water and a new sun
beats.text: Her talons close on Crawler Carl's legs and chest and pull, and his health flashes red. Crawler Donut's Magic Missile hits her wing. Crawler Carl heals and smashes a Holy Gooper against the talon on his chest; the foot sizzles, and she only crushes harder. Then Crawler Donut rises out of the canopy with her light turned up like a new sun. The boss rears back, her head bursts into flames, and she flings Crawler Carl straight up into the sky before landing on her back atop the trees.
beats.gist: Sierra pulls Carl's legs and chest with her talons until his health flashes red.

beats.headline: A branch through the heart
beats.text: Sierra, northropi vampire, is dead. Crawler Carl falls out of the sky onto her, fist first, and tears through her chest. She hangs impaled between two trees with her head burning and her guts falling on him, her health in the red and refusing to drop further. Her heart lies on the ground, still beating in time to the music. Crawler Carl picks up a jagged broken branch and stabs it into the organ, and she explodes. Winner! Crawler Donut announces that he punched her in the lady garden.
beats.gist: Carl falls from the sky and tears through Sierra's chest, then stabs her beating heart.

beats.headline: His flying mount
beats.text: In the clearing, Crawler Carl tells Miriam Dom that they have just killed Viscount Fog's flying mount, Sierra. Miriam's answer: good. She was dangerous. Fog, she explains, was the star of one of the programs this place runs, and started hunting her the moment she landed on this floor. The viewer counter has been jacked all the way to the right since the boss battle.
beats.gist: Carl tells Miriam Dom they killed Viscount Fog's flying mount, Sierra, in the clearing.
